card.name: Time spans like generation and years
card.fires_on: Words about spans of time such as generation, years, year, or time, and nearby words like to or in, in general web prose about history or social change.

modes.label: Time-span nouns
modes.description: Nouns for a stretch of time such as generation, years, or year after for, a, or the next.
modes.example: go on to dominate an entire area of research for a<< generation>>. It seems as if his creativity knew

modes.label: Linking words in change over time
modes.description: Small words like to, in, or as inside phrases about things changing or taking time.
modes.example: it takes generations<< to>> recover. Health and Social Problems are Worse

card.plain: It lights up on words about how long things take or how things change over years and generations.
